|game_text=Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. May deploy an opponent's lightsaber just lost from same site on him (for free); may then use two weapons. While [[The Quick And Easy Path]] on table, [[Jedi Escape]] and [[What Was It?]] may not cancel duels. Immune to attrition < 5.
|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Lord Vader (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The images here are the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB3-D-lordvader-pre.gif]]) and the Virtual Block 3 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB3-13E-Lord_Vader.png]]); both show this text. The PC-E1 text is shown by a CardMaker recreation on [[Lord Vader (V) (Errata)]].
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 3 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009; slip 13E)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 2, slip 13E. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174313/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref>: “[Pilot] 3. May deploy an opponent's lightsaber just lost from same site on him (for free); may then use two weapons. While The Quick And Easy Path on table, Jedi Escape and What Was It? may not cancel duels. Immune to attrition < 5.” The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) showed the same text (marked “Errata Text - September 9th, 2009”).<ref name="cl-1230_13-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock3Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064716/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> The game text above writes the pilot icon “3” out as “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots”.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Lord Vader (V) (Errata)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) changed “May deploy an opponent's lightsaber just lost from same site on him (for free)” to “May steal (and then use) an opponent's lightsaber just lost from same site” (slip marked E): “[Pilot] 3. May steal (and then use) an opponent's lightsaber just lost from same site; may then use two weapons. While The Quick And Easy Path on table, Jedi Escape and What Was It? may not cancel duels. Immune to attrition < 5.”<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=11, page 11. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=11 Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee posted this errata on its rules forum on 30 December 2013<ref name="pcforum-p858387">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574, now titled “Current Rulings Archive August 2012 - December 2015”), post by Lukes Bionic Hand, 30 December 2013 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=20#p858387 forum post])</ref>, so this version dates from then (the Master List that prints it was compiled until February 2014).
